zh.title: VietJet 11月13日將再赴倫敦法院處理約2.5億美元租機債務爭議
zh.summary: VietJet 11月13日將赴倫敦法院處理約2.5億美元債務爭議。
body: VietJet預定於2026年11月13日再赴倫敦法院，處理與飛機租賃業者FW Aviation之間約2.5億美元的債務爭議。案件焦點是VietJet是否還須就四架租用的Airbus A321支付額外款項。
付款安排的報導不一。一名知悉此事的人士告訴路透社，VietJet稱已安排資金，並希望在開庭日期前付款；另有報導質疑該說法，稱航空公司仍在進行訴訟，同時對和解持開放態度。
英國高等法院於2025年4月命令VietJet支付約1.815億美元；報導指出，利息與費用已使債務升至約2.5億美元。

en.title: VietJet due back in London court November 13 over roughly $250 million aircraft debt dispute
en.summary: VietJet is due back in London court November 13, 2026, over roughly $250 million owed to FW Aviation.
body: VietJet is due back in a London court on November 13, 2026, over roughly $250 million it owes aircraft lessor FW Aviation. The issue is whether the airline owes additional sums relating to four leased Airbus A321s.

Accounts of VietJet's payment position differ. One of two people familiar with the matter told Reuters that VietJet said it had lined up the money and aimed to pay by the hearing date. Other reporting challenged that account, saying the airline was still pursuing its case while remaining open to a settlement.
In April 2025, the UK High Court ordered VietJet to pay about $181.5 million. Interest and costs have since pushed the debt to roughly $250 million.
